test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following thematic areas under the ‘Deep Ocean Mission’ is being implemented by the Centre for Marine Living Resources?

options.text: Technological innovations for exploration and conservation of deep-sea biodiversity
Development of ocean climate change advisory services
Energy and fresh water from the ocean

solution:
The correct answer is __**technological innovations for the exploration and conservation of deep-sea biodiversity**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The deep ocean mission is a **five-year inter-ministerial and inter-departmental mission.**​
 
• The government allocated** Rs. 4,077 Cr in 2021.**
 
• **The deep ocean mission has 6 major components:**

 
 

 **Components**
 **Objectives**
 
 

 **Technological innovations for the exploration and conservation of deep-sea biodiversity **
 
 
 
• The sustainable utilization of bio-resources.
 
• Bio-prospecting of deep-sea flora and fauna because deep-sea harbours the highest biodiversity on earth.
 
• Implemented by the Centre for Marine Living Resources in association with the National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT) and Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC).
 
 
 
 

 **Development of ocean climate change advisory services**
 
 
 
• This entails the development of models to provide future projections of important climate variables on seasonal to decadal time scales. 
 
• Implemented by the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES).
 
 
 
 

 **Energy and fresh water from the ocean **
 
 
 
• Supports the off-shore energy development by studying and designing Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion (OTEC) powered desalination plants.
 
 
 
 

 **Deep ocean survey and exploration** 
 
 
 
• To explore and identify potential sites of multi-metal Hydrothermal Sulphides mineralization along the Indian Ocean mid-oceanic ridges.
 
 
 
 

 **Development of Technologies for Deep Sea Mining, and Manned Submersible**
 
 
 
• Development of an integrated mining system to extract poly-metallic nodules in the Central Indian Ocean.
 
 
 
 

 **Advanced Marine Station for Ocean Biology.**
 
 
 
• Aimed at capacity building, encouraging enterprise and engineering in ocean biology.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Centre for Marine Living Resources and Ecology:**

 
 
• Established in** 1998.**
 
• **HQ: **Kochi, Kerala
 
• Under the administrative control of the **Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES).**
